meta.comment: Phase-3 realm ladder (ROADMAP 'Realms (JSON-driven)'). The canonical 15-tier DESIGN.md progression (Mortal → Beyond Heaven): ids and names follow DESIGN.md 'Realms' exactly. Balancing multipliers are monotonic placeholder curves — Phase 10 Balancing retunes them. The Breakthroughs roadmap item will consume this collection; the per-realm 'unlocks' arrays stay empty placeholders until the unlock-bearing systems land.

definitions.name: Mortal
definitions.description: The starting realm of every new life, before cultivation begins.

definitions.name: Qi Gathering
definitions.description: The first realm on the path of cultivation — the body begins drawing in and refining ambient qi.

definitions.name: Foundation Establishment
definitions.description: The cultivator lays a stable foundation, anchoring qi in the body.

definitions.name: Core Formation
definitions.description: The cultivator condenses refined qi into a solid core.

definitions.name: Nascent Soul
definitions.description: The cultivator births a nascent soul from the formed core.

definitions.name: Soul Transformation
definitions.description: The cultivator transforms and strengthens the nascent soul.

definitions.name: Void Refinement
definitions.description: The cultivator refines the void within, purifying qi and soul alike.

definitions.name: Body Integration
definitions.description: The cultivator integrates the body with qi, strengthening flesh and spirit as one.

definitions.name: Great Ascension
definitions.description: The cultivator approaches the limits of the mortal world, readying for ascension.

definitions.name: True Immortal
definitions.description: The first immortal realm — the cultivator sheds mortality and gains an immortal body.

definitions.name: Celestial Immortal
definitions.description: The cultivator ascends into the celestial heavens.

definitions.name: Golden Immortal
definitions.description: The cultivator's immortal body and soul become imperishable, tempered to gold.

definitions.name: Dao Lord
definitions.description: The cultivator grasps and embodies a Dao, becoming a lord of their own path.

definitions.name: Heavenly Sovereign
definitions.description: The cultivator's authority spans the heavens themselves.

definitions.name: Beyond Heaven
definitions.description: The final realm — the cultivator transcends heaven and all within it.
